title: Price nine coordinate calls beside one idle dirty auxiliary
body:
## Summary
- On four roles, the nine factors `D_{E_ww}([E_ii])` multiply to `diag([I],[I],[I],[0])`. The fourth role is a dirty auxiliary and is restored because no factor writes it.
- Every assignment of eight coordinate-projector calls leaves some data register with at most two frames, so that register cannot hold `I`.
- The published span test still leaves dimensions 4, 5 and 6 open for a general eight-call word. This package does not classify the 120 four-register projectors. No new exponent.

## Test plan
